title: Joe Oliver coming through Savannah
summary: He saw Joe Oliver's band before Oliver went to Chicago; Louis was not with him then.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: And they'd come through there. Joe Oliver would come through Savannah. But Joe Oliver -- when I knew Joe Oliver was coming through there -- Louis wasn't with Joe Oliver at that particular time.
When Joe Oliver came to Savannah that you saw him, what year would that have been? Around what year?
Oh, that would have been before he went to Chicago. That would -- I think he went to Chicago around 1919, 1920 or somewhere around there.
Because it was shortly after that that Barney joined him I know.
Yeah, Barney joined them after that.
So, it was right before then.
